target.statement: Random Forest (and Logistic Regression) achieve 0.99 classification accuracy on the UCI CKD dataset (Table I, 'Proposed' row)
target.dataset: UCI Chronic Kidney Disease dataset (400 instances, 25 features)

compute.basis: UCI CKD is a tiny 400x25 table; training RF/LR and 8 classifiers takes seconds, so time is dominated by pip installs and dataset download.

blockers: No code released; preprocessing (random imputation vs mean/mode, encoding, split seed) must be reimplemented, so exact 0.99 may not reproduce
Paper has internal inconsistencies (e.g., 250 CKD/150 not-CKD vs standard 400-row UCI set) that could shift results
title: Performance Analysis of Machine Learning Algorithms in Chronic Kidney Disease Prediction
